_team_scope_note: PMN records the team in two different fields depending on issue type: cf[10040] 'Epic Team' is set on epics, cf[10098] 'Team Name' on stories/bugs/tasks. any_clause is the union (112 issues total via either field); bug_clause is what bugs actually carry -- confirmed 0 bugs have cf[10040] set, matching the CV-Tech/Ascenders/Fellowship pattern.
_forecast_note: Phoenix has 0 delivered epics in every one of the last 5 releases (25.3/25.4/26.1/26.2/26.3) -- a brand-new team, only active starting 26.4, where it has delivered 5 so far. With no history at all, neither a regression nor a %-over-last-release approach applies (last release was 0), so Kobi gave the team's actual stated target directly (2026-09-15): 8 epics.
_recipients_note: Recipient addresses are NOT in this file -- the repo is public. They come from the PHOENIX_DASHBOARD_RECIPIENTS secret (semicolon-separated); the test audience comes from PMN_DASHBOARD_TEST_RECIPIENT. cc_env is optional and only applied on a real 'managers' send, never on a test/personal copy.
